prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Make an iPad timeline editor work with pointer input. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS/macOS. All actions require hover, right-click deletes clips immediately and pointer shape changes randomly over blank regions. Touch users still need the same editing task and keyboard modifiers are undocumented.

criteria.task_completion: Patch predictable pointer affordances, context actions, selection/drag precision and touch-equivalent commands, retaining system cursor behavior and discoverable modifiers.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the pointing-devices guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
